create_LKJCholesky: create an LKJCholesky distribution with a given dimension and concentration parameter
sample_LKJCholesky: sample lower Cholesky factors of correlation matrices from an LKJCholesky distribution
compute_log_prob_LKJCholesky: compute the log probability of a Cholesky factor under an LKJCholesky distribution
expand_LKJCholesky: expand the batch shape of an LKJCholesky distribution
get_LKJCholesky_support: get the Cholesky correlation matrix constraint support for an LKJCholesky distribution
